get.summary: Download a paste without a password
get.description: Returns an accessible, non-password-protected static paste. Responses: 200 with `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="..."`; 400 when any `password` query parameter is present; 401 when the paste requires a password; 404 when the paste is private, expired, or missing. Every response includes `Cache-Control: no-store`. A 200 response increments `hits` exactly once.

200.description: Paste content delivered as a UTF-8 text file.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename derived from the sanitized paste title.

400.description: Invalid slug or a forbidden password query was supplied.

401.description: A password is required; use POST with a JSON body.

404.description: Paste is missing, expired, private, or inaccessible.

post.description: Requires an `application/json` body shaped as `{ "password": "non-empty string" }`. Responses: 200 with `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="..."`; 400 for a missing, malformed, or invalid body or when the paste does not require a password; 403 for an incorrect password; 404 when the paste is private, expired, or missing. Route-handled responses include `Cache-Control: no-store`; an oversized body can receive a global 413 before route middleware. A 200 response increments `hits` exactly once.

200.description: Paste content delivered as a UTF-8 text file.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename derived from the sanitized paste title.

400.description: Invalid body, missing password, or unprotected paste.
